messages.subject: simple "value-date" plot
parts:
Hi all!
I'm using R/reshape/ggplot 2 for some kind of little reporting-
analysis system for our project. All traditional factor-response
analysis, histograms going great, but I have [at least] one stupid
question:
Is there a simple way to draw a simple *line* chart with date (days)
on X axis and numeric value on Y?
F.e.:
date visits
2009-05-26 4567
2009-05-27 3950
...

or two lines on chart (one for visits_web and one for vists wap)
date visits_web visits_wap
2009-05-26 4567 2470
2009-05-27 3950 2100
...

Any help will be highly appreciated.

of course there is, if I understand correctly:

df = data.frame(day=seq(from=as.Date("2007-12-12") ,
to=as.Date("2008-12-12"), by="day"),
visits=rnorm(367, 5000, 400),
visits_wap=rnorm(367, 4000, 200))

# one line
p = qplot(x=day, y=visits, data=df, geom="line")
print(p)
# add second line
p + geom_line(aes(x=day, y=visits_wap))

You can modify the ways the labels of the x axis are displayed using
scale_date(..)
http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/scale_date.html


regards,
